title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Corrected Claim Reference: Patient-Identification Denials
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — corrected claims for patient-identification denials (CO-31).** When a payer denies a claim because the patient was not identified, Halverson Clinical Laboratories files a corrected claim with the patient's details corrected. An identification correction answers the claim's most recent patient-identification denial and carries the denied amount being resubmitted, as the company's rule for identification corrections fixes it.

## Capability

`file_identification_correction_4ff16e31` records one corrected-claim resubmission, dated today, on the claim ledger of the coverage the claim was filed with, under the original claim number, linked to the patient-identification denial line it answers and carrying the amount put back in front of the plan. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes. On success the corrected claim appears in the coverage's claim history.

## Invocation

Agent-side: the agent unlocks `file_identification_correction_4ff16e31` and then calls it.

## Parameters

- **`coverage_id`** — reference number of the coverage the corrected claim goes to, as returned by the coverage lookup (Id).
- **`customer_id`** — the patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup (Id).
- **`claim_number`** — laboratory claim number of the claim being corrected, written as 'C' followed by 10 digits exactly as shown on the claim history.
- **`order_id`** — reference number of the order the corrected claim bills, as shown on the claim history line (Id).
- **`source_claim_event_id`** — reference number of the patient-identification denial line the corrected claim answers, as returned by the claim-history lookup (Id).
- **`rebill_amount`** — amount the corrected claim puts back in front of the plan, in USD with 2 decimal places, a non-negative number rounded half up to the cent.

## Return

On success a text receipt: `claim_event_id` (reference number of the new resubmission); `event_type` `coverage_claim_resubmitted` and `resubmission_reason` `corrected_claim`, together confirming a corrected claim was recorded; `claim_number` (the claim corrected); `amount` (the amount put back, USD with 2 decimal places); `event_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the corrected claim was recorded.

## Hypothetical input and receipt

Input: `claim_number` C0000012345, `rebill_amount` 88.40, with the coverage, patient, order and denial-line references from the lookups. Receipt: a new `claim_event_id`, `event_type` `coverage_claim_resubmitted`, `resubmission_reason` `corrected_claim`, `claim_number` C0000012345, `amount` 88.4, `event_date` today.
